title: Multi-forge federation
alt: praetorctl builds only the GitHub driver; GitLab and Gitea drivers come from forge.NewForge, which only tests call.
text: praetorctl commands: sync --remote (reconcileRemoteForge), issue reconcile (loadFleetIssues), needs epic --publish (publishEpicToForge), GitHub driver (NewGitHubDriver, REST client).
Tests only, no production caller: forge package tests (forge_test.go), forge.NewForge (provider switch), GitLab driver (token check only), Gitea driver (gitea or forgejo).
issue reconcile → GitHub driver (list, relabel, tick, close).
needs epic --publish → GitHub driver (list, create, link).
forge package tests → forge.NewForge (NewForge) → GitLab driver (gitlab).

Scenario 1, sync --remote: sync --remote writes the branch ruleset, the label taxonomy and the repository metadata through the GitHub driver. reconcileRemoteForge checks the token, repository and origin, then calls forge.NewGitHubDriver. ReconcileProtection writes the ruleset for main and lts-* and reads it back. ReconcileLabels updates, or creates, each label from .config/labels.yaml. ReconcileRepositoryMetadata writes the declared description, homepage and missing topics, and reports visibility drift.

Scenario 2, issue reconcile: issue reconcile lists the issues of each selected repository, relabels the unblocked ones and runs the planning sync. loadFleetIssues builds a GitHub driver per repository and calls ListIssues. With --apply, transitionUnblocked calls AddLabels, then RemoveLabel. With --apply, ApplyPlanning re-reads each parent, ticks closed children with EditIssueBody and closes a finished epic with UpdateIssue.

Scenario 3, needs epic --publish: needs epic --publish creates the missing epic issues through the GitHub driver and names each child in the parent. publishEpicToForge passes the GitHub driver to needs.PublishPreMigrationEpic. PrepareIssueBatch checks the token and lists the existing issues by title. IssueBatch.Ensure calls CreateIssue only for a title the forge does not have yet. Once every child exists, linkEpicChildren writes a task-list line per child into the parent with EditIssueBody.
(Shortened to 2500 characters; docs/figures/forge-federation.ts holds the full content.)
